publish.intro: Write it once and it goes out on all your accounts at the time you planned 🚀
publish.needWorker: Auto-posting needs the Scout Worker and your connected accounts in Settings.
publish.net.manual: You post this one (no free API)
publish.net.notSetUp: Not set up in the Worker
publish.mediaDirect: We will use the direct link:
publish.mediaHint: Paste a public link to the file itself (MP4 or JPG). Dropbox and Google Drive share links are turned into direct links for you; just set the file to “anyone with the link can view”.
publish.captionsHint: Every network gets the Overview caption and hashtags; edit any one if you like.
publish.captionsEmpty: No caption in Overview yet: write it there, or here per network.
publish.trimmedHint: Over the {platform} limit: trailing hashtags are dropped and the rest is cut so it still goes out.
publish.warn.tooLong: The {platform} caption is over {limit} characters; shorten it when you post it yourself (the rest is not held up).
publish.yt.title: YouTube
publish.yt.note: YouTube keeps uploads private while the Google Cloud project has not passed its audit; once approved they go public. A vertical video under 3 minutes becomes a Short by itself.
publish.tt.title: TikTok
publish.tt.mode.inbox: To the TikTok inbox, finish it on the phone
publish.tt.note: Direct posting requires permission and follows TikTok's app approval and creator limits. Private utility apps are not eligible for its standard public-posting audit. The inbox option lets you add sounds and finish publishing in TikTok.
publish.whenNone: Pick a day in Overview, or press “Post now”.
publish.err.notConnected: The account is not connected; connect it in Settings.
publish.err.tokenExpired: The connection expired; reconnect the account.
publish.err.mediaUnreachable: Could not reach the file; make sure the link is public and opens the file itself.
publish.err.mediaTooLarge: The file is too large for this network.
publish.err.privateAccount: Until TikTok reviews our app, it only takes posts while the account is private; make the account private in TikTok settings and try again.
publish.err.rateLimited: The network asked us to slow down
publish.err.timeout: Processing took too long; try again.
publish.problem.manualOnly: X and Snapchat are posted by hand: copy the caption and open the app when it is time. Pick another network to schedule.
publish.problem.noDay: Give the post a day in Overview.
publish.problem.noMedia: Add the video or image link.
publish.problem.badUrl: The link must start with https://
publish.problem.needsMedia: {platform} needs a video or an image.
publish.problem.notConnected: {platform} is not connected; connect it in Settings.
publish.problem.noPermission: {platform} has no posting permission; press “Allow posting”.
publish.todo: {n} things left before it can go out.
publish.scheduled: Done! It goes out on time ⏰
publish.sentNow: Publishing started 🚀 videos take a few minutes.
publish.updateHint: Changed the caption or the time? The change reaches the schedule by itself a moment later; press “Update schedule” to send it right away.
publish.hub.title: Auto-posting
publish.hub.sub: Every scheduled post, how far it got, and which accounts can post by themselves.
publish.hub.empty: Nothing scheduled yet. Open a post in the calendar and pick the 🚀 tab.
publish.hub.manual: X and Snapchat have no free publishing API: they wait below under “Post these yourself” with the caption ready to copy.
publish.hub.manualSub: Posts with X or Snapchat: copy the caption and open the app when it is time, then mark the post posted.
publish.hub.remoteTitle: 📡 On the Worker from another device
publish.hub.remoteSub: Posts scheduled from your phone or another browser, or before this browser was cleared. Follow them and cancel them here.
publish.hub.remoteConfirmBody: “{name}” has not gone out on every network yet. What is already out stays out; the rest will not be posted.
publish.tokenToday: 🔑 Reconnect today, the connection is about to expire
publish.problem.photoOnlyTikTok: Photo carousels currently support TikTok only. Choose only TikTok for this post.
publish.problem.photoCover: Choose a cover from your photo list.
publish.problem.tiktokPrivacy: Choose an available TikTok audience after checking the connected creator.
publish.problem.tiktokConsent: Review the TikTok preview, disclosures and music terms, then check the confirmation.
publish.problem.tiktokDuration: Enter the video's duration and keep it within this creator's TikTok limit.
publish.problem.tiktokBrandedPrivacy: Branded content cannot use the Only me audience.
publish.problem.tiktokCreator: Direct posting needs a fresh creator check. Refresh here; if unavailable, update the Worker or reconnect with direct-post permission. You can still use the inbox route when upload permission is available.
publish.tt.personal: Keep your Personal account. Send to TikTok's inbox to choose your trending sound and finish publishing in the app.
publish.tt.directNote: Direct posting skips TikTok's sound picker. Availability and audiences depend on your account and this app's TikTok approval; an upload is never silently changed to public.
publish.tt.inboxNote: The scheduled time sends an upload to your TikTok inbox. It does not publish the post. Open the notification on your phone, add a sound, review and publish.
publish.tt.disabledByCreator: unavailable for this account or media
publish.tt.ownBrand: Promote my own brand or business
publish.tt.branded: Promote another brand through a paid partnership
publish.tt.promotional: TikTok will label this Promotional content.
publish.tt.paidPartnership: TikTok will label this Paid partnership. This content cannot be Only me.
publish.tt.consent: I reviewed this post and agree to TikTok's music usage confirmation and any applicable branded-content policy.
publish.tt.verifiedUrl: TikTok needs public HTTPS file links on a domain or URL prefix verified in your TikTok developer app. An ordinary Drive or Dropbox share link is not enough unless its source is verified.
publish.tt.finishTitle: Your upload is ready. Finish in TikTok.
publish.tt.finishSteps: Open TikTok on your phone → Inbox → the upload notification. Choose your sound, check the caption and audience, then publish. This upload is not counted as a posted video yet.
publish.tt.postLink: Link to the post you published
publish.tt.finishedConfirm: I have published this post in TikTok.
publish.tt.fullLink: Use the full tiktok.com/@account/video/ID or /photo/ID link, not a profile or short share link.
publish.photo.hint: Add 1–35 JPG or WebP files in display order. Each needs a public HTTPS link on a domain or URL prefix verified in your TikTok developer app.
publish.photo.title: Photo title (up to 90 characters)
publish.photo.autoMusic: Let TikTok choose music automatically (this does not choose a specific trending sound)
publish.photo.description: The TikTok caption below is the photo description. Use the inbox route when you want to choose your own sound before posting.
